root_cause: The only failing check is the OoO evidence check ooo_load_overlap_rename ('missing issue evidence'): dbg_ooo_issue never asserts. Because the program still retires correctly (trace_mismatches empty, only 1 failed check, other suites pass), the data path is not the problem — the issue evidence is. Either the IQ→FU issue-accept event never drives dbg_ooo_issue (the pulse is conditioned on a rare bypass-only case, generated from dispatch/rename instead of accept, qualified by a same-cycle flag or a dead/near-duplicate top-level wire), or the issue queue never issues out of order (it issues only the ROB-head entry or blocks all issue behind an older outstanding load), so a younger independent ALU instruction is never accepted by a functional unit while the load is in flight. The fix must derive dbg_ooo_issue from the real IQ→FU accept handshake (iq_accept && !is_ecall || lsq_accept, one pulse per instruction) and make issue selection scan all valid entries for readiness.
repair_constraints: Port, module and file names are binding-frozen: rv32i5, icache, dcache, branch_predictor, if_stage, id_stage, rename_unit, physical_register_file, issue_queue, execute_alu, load_store_unit, reorder_buffer, commit_unit and every port listed in the plan contract must keep their exact names/widths/directions.

dbg_ooo_issue must be produced from real internal state: one single-cycle pulse on the cycle a valid issue-queue entry is actually accepted by a functional unit (iq_accept && !is_ecall || lsq_accept); it must not be fabricated from counters or PC patterns, must not be tied to dispatch/rename events, and must not be qualified by a flag set in the same cycle by an NBA.
dbg_ooo_bypass must stay tied to real internal state (an older incomplete load exists while a younger independent integer ALU instruction is issued and completes).

Issue selection must be truly out-of-order: a younger instruction whose source PRs are ready must issue without waiting for any older load or for the ROB head; dispatch (rename→IQ, in-order enqueue) and issue (IQ→FU, out-of-order dequeue) must stay separated, and iq_disp_ready must remain asserted while an older load is outstanding so rename can overlap.
